arabic text:
DARIYA PE JO POHCHA ASADULLAH KA PYARA
ABBAS HAI ABBAS..(2)
DARIYA PE JO POHCHA ASADULLAH KA PYARA
LALKAR KE PHIR FAUJ KO GHAZI YE PUKARA
TUM SAB YEHI KEHTE THE KE DARIYA HAI HUMARA
AB DEKHO KE DARIYA HAI HUMARA KE TUMHARA
LO CHEENLO YE HUM HAI YE QABZA HAI HAMARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(4)
english translation text:
When the beloved of the Lion of God reached the river—
Abbas! Abbas!
When the beloved of the Lion of God reached the river,
Ghazi challenged the army and cried:
you all claimed this river was yours;
now see whether it belongs to you or to us.
Come and take it—here we stand; it is now under our command.
The river is ours.

arabic text:
ABBAS KA NARA HAI ALAMDAR KA NARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
LO CHEENLO YE HUM HAI YE QABZA HAI HAMARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
ABBAS E ALAMDAR, ALAMDAR, ALAMDAR..(3)
english translation text:
This is Abbas's cry, the standard-bearer's cry:
the river is ours.
Come and take it—here we stand; it is under our command.
The river is ours.
Abbas the standard-bearer!

arabic text:
MAI HAIDER E QARRAR KE SAAYE ME PALA HU
MAI FATIMA ZAHRA KI DUAO KA SILA HU
ABBAS MERA NAAM ALAMDAR E WAFA HU
YE NAAM O NASAB HAI MERI QISMAT KA SITARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
I was raised beneath the shade of Haider-e-Karrar.
I am the answer to Fatima Zahra's prayers.
My name is Abbas, the standard-bearer of loyalty.
This name and lineage are the stars of my destiny.
The river is ours.

arabic text:
AAQA KI DUAO KA KARAM SAATH HAI MERE
DEKHO BANI HASHIM KA HASHAM SAATH HAI MERE
RUTBA HAI ALAMDAR ALAM SAATH HAI MERE
LEHRAKE FARERA BHI YE KARTA HAI ISHARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
My Master's prayers and grace are with me.
Behold, the majesty of Bani Hashim stands with me.
My rank is that of the standard-bearer, and the standard is with me.
Even its fluttering banner gives this signal:
the river is ours.

arabic text:
SAHIL PE JO YE FAUJ KE DASTE HAI TUMHARE
EK AAN MEIN PAYWAND E ZAMEE'N HO ABHI SAARE
DARIYA ULAT AAYE ABHI QADMO'N ME HUMARE
EK HASHR BAPA KARDU MAI KARDU JO ISHARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
These units of your army standing upon the bank
can all be buried within the earth in a single moment.
The river itself could reverse and come beneath our feet
if I but give one command and bring about Judgement Day.
The river is ours.

arabic text:
KHAT BHEJ KE TUMNE JINHE YASRAB SE BULAYA
MEHMAN THE LEKIN UNHE DARIYA SE HATAYA
PYAASE HI RAHE WO UNHE PAANI NA PILAYA
ALLAH NE JINKE LIYE KAUSAR KO UTARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
You sent letters and called them from Yathrib.
They were your guests, yet you drove them away from the river.
They remained thirsty, and you refused them water—
those for whom Allah created Kawthar.
The river is ours.

arabic text:
YE HUKM HAI AAKA KA NA TALWAR UTHANA
WARNA MERI ZARBO SE LARAZTA YE ZAMANA
YE FAUJ E JAFAKAAR YE ZALIM KA THIKANA
EK NAIZE SE NAQSHA HI BADAL JAYEGA SAARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
My Master has commanded me not to draw my sword.
Otherwise, the world would tremble beneath my blows.
This army of oppressors, this tyrant's camp—
one strike of the spear would change its entire appearance.
The river is ours.

arabic text:
LO CHEENLO YE HUM HAI YE QABZA HAI HAMARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
ABBAS KA NARA HAI ALAMDAR KA NARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
Come and take it—here we stand; it is under our command.
The river is ours.
This is Abbas's cry, the standard-bearer's cry:
the river is ours.

arabic text:
KYA FAUJ KI TADAAD BATATE HO HUME TUM
HUM DEKHE KE KIS TARHA HATATE HO HUME TUM
KIS HAKIM O JABIR SE DARATE HO HUME TUM
AB NAAM NA LENA KISI HAKIM KA DOBARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
Why do you tell us the number of your army?
Let us see how you intend to move us from here.
Which ruler and oppressor are you using to frighten us?
Never mention any ruler's name before us again.
The river is ours.

arabic text:
PYAASA HU MAGAR SUNLE SABHI DUSHMAN E JAANI
PAANI MUJHE PEENA NAHI LEJANA HAI PAANI
HAYE MERE MASOOMO KI WO TISHNA DAHANI
HAI MASHK E SAKINA UNHI PYAASO KA SAHARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
I am thirsty, but listen, O mortal enemies:
I have not come to drink; I have come to take water.
Alas for my innocent thirsty children!
Sakina's water-skin is their only hope.
The river is ours.

arabic text:
TAREEKH NE DEKHA NA HILAL AISA WAFADAR
AB BHI HAI TARAYI KI ZAMEE'N PAR WO DILAFGAR
WO DEKH ZARA ROZA E ABBAS E ALAMDAR
EK ZINDA GAWAHI HAI YE MARQAD KA NAZARA
DARIYA HAI HUMARA..(2)
english translation text:
History has never seen a moon so faithful.
Even now he lies wounded upon the land of Karbala.
Look upon the shrine of Abbas the standard-bearer:
this resting place remains a living testimony.
The river is ours.
